[EN] Not to mention the Vanguard Scouts, but a lot of funds were spent in the name of Elleon.

I just wish that all the things that Elleon did for the federation wouldn't end up being so useless.
[ES] Sin mencionar a los exploradores de la Vanguard, se gastaron muchos fondos en nombre de Elleon.

Solo desearía que todo lo que Elleon hizo por la federación no termine siendo tan inútil.
